{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.36
|gr1= DLC
|arg= global

|descr= Returns appID of the DLC the object belongs to or [[nil]] if object is vanilla.

|s1= [[getObjectDLC]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]] (or [[Nothing]] if vanilla item)

|x1= <sqf>
_appID = getObjectDLC cursorTarget;
if (!isNil "_appID") then {
	hint format ["This object belongs to DLC with id: %1", _appID];
} else {
	hint "This object is vanilla";
};
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_akm = createSimpleObject ["A3\Weapons_F_Exp\Rifles\AKM\AKM_F.p3d",getPosASL player];
getObjectDLC _akm;	// 395180
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getDLCs]] [[getPersonUsedDLCs]] [[getMissionDLCs]] [[getDLCAssetsUsageByName]] [[getDLCAssetsUsage]] [[getAssetDLCInfo]]
}}
